newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-James Hardie sees year profit fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-James Hardie sees year profit fall.

text.p: Building materials group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that a depressed Australian housing market would cause a marked deterioration in profits for the six months to September 30 just completed.
It said profits for the full year to March 31, 1997 would be lower than the previous year.
James Hardie also announced it would be building a fourth fibre cement plant in the United States.

"While U.S. demand for fibre cement continues to expand ahead of our most optimistic forecasts, the full benefits of this growth will not flow through to James Hardies profits until additional production capacity comes on stream next year," James Hardie managing director Keith Barton said in a statement.

"In the meantime, the very depressed state of housing markets in Australia is having a much more severe impact than expected on the building materials sector and this will be reflected in a marked deterioration in our group results for the six months just finished and a lower profit for the full year to March 1997," Barton said.
